gaps.current: result(kind, amount, hold, label) is one fixed style for every machine and every size: a 0.12 s steps(3) pop (seatHud.css:20-25), no tier input, no count-up of the amount, no shake or glow for big wins. gaps.proposal: Add an optional tier argument (juiceTier from settle/paySeat). tier >= big gets an r-big class: outBack scale slam via CSS keyframes, gold glow, the amount counts up 0 to net over ~0.8 s with a numberTick per step (same shape as juice.countUp, sim clock). Big losses get a red tint and a short ctx.fx.shake(0.006). Move the hold onto the sim clock (ctx.timers.wait) so the callout survives hit-stop. One change lifts every seated machine.

CROSS-CUTTING NOTES
1. Pacing: celebrate is fire-and-forget (juice.ts:150-186) and does not set busy. Roulette (:480), sicbo (:405), sonkart (:753), tombola (:381), videopoker (:484) all do not await it, so the next round's lock chime can talk over a 7 s mega show. A round's restore callback (e.g. roulette :480 paintLamps) can repaint lamps mid-round. Consider a short hold (~0.8 s) on medium+ wins; this trades throughput for feel.
2. Stacking: big tier adds winBurst 40 coins (core/fx.ts:194) plus escalate 60 coins and a second shake (juice.ts:221-222); huge plays winHuge's own riser at t=0 (sfx.ts:478) and winRise at 0.4 s (juice.ts:226), so two risers overlap; jackpot layers fanfare, siren loop, bells and coin-rain loop (juice.ts:241-243). Worth one riser per tier and ducking.
3. Particle ring: coins (cap 256) evict the oldest on overflow (particles.ts:198-203). winBurst bypasses the 60-per-call guard in FxApi.coins (core/fx.ts:178-229 calls ps.burst with 160-200), so a mega or jackpot can evict an earlier pour. Probably intended, but worth knowing before adding more coin layers.
4. Fast mode: MachineBase.ts:394 sets fast when more than 4 events are pending; it skips escalation but keeps winBurst and winJingle, which is the right degradation.
5. Doc drift: videopoker header (:14-15) promises a CRT glitch that does not exist.

Existing strengths to build on, not rewrite: tier curve (tiers.ts:95-147), the double-or-nothing ladder and all-in shot (riskLayer.ts), the win and tension sfx library (sfx.ts), tallytable's cut-ins, teetotum's spin, sicbo's rattle and triple stamp.
